newsitem.title: USA: Chicago finance panel okays $49.2 mln tax refund.
newsitem.headline: Chicago finance panel okays $49.2 mln tax refund.

text.p: A Chicago City Council committee approved Thursday refunding $49.2 million of a special use tax that was to fund a downtown trolley system never built, a finance committee attorney said Friday.
The tax had been instituted to help finance a $775 million surface transportation system that was to link the shopping and entertainment districts downtown with commuter rail services.
Any taxes owed by the businesses will offset the refunds due them under the ordinance, which now moves to the full city council for approval later this month, the attorney said.
